# loop

Create a lightweight CAESAR automation loop backed by DCode runtime memory.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `runtime.loop` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Runtime Blocks |
| Family | Loop |
| Monaco kind | `runtime_block` |
| Format | `loop <name> <frequency_hz>:` |
| Valid contexts | `file` |
| Autocomplete | `loop name 10:<br>    local current = \|portal/channel.value\|<br>` |

## Lifecycle

Activation starts a named repeated body at the requested frequency under a CAESAR loop controller.

## Persistence

The state table survives iterations for the active runtime object.

## Runtime-memory fingerprinting

The loop publishes the activation source hash used to identify its loaded implementation.

## Runtime sections

- `loop body`

## Example

```lua
loop name 10:
    local current = |portal/channel.value|
```
